title: Shapes with an interface
promptMd: Define an interface `Shape` with a method `double area()`, and classes `Circle` and `Square` that implement it. Input: `n`, then n lines like `circle 1` or `square 2`. Print each area with two decimals, one per line.

requiredPatterns.message: Your shape classes should implement Shape.

hints: An interface only declares the method; each class provides its own area().
Store each shape in a variable of type Shape, then call area() on it.
Use Math.PI for π and format with two decimal places.
